tickets.name: Lob City
tickets.note: Adebayo drives, the rest ride along. Atomic Adebayo gets the jump on the jump ball, and the Heat are in business. Turner wins it clean, then camps out on the block waiting for the entry pass. The Jazz run it to Bailey like water running downhill. Hotter than a skillet in July! Now here's a name nobody circled: Watson for the Cavaliers. Four doors, four keys, let's open 'em up.

tickets.name: The Shot
tickets.note: Four games, four tips, one parade. The Heat send Adebayo to the circle, and the circle sends the ball to the Heat. Turner gets a fingernail on the toss, and a fingernail is all he needs. Hum diddly dee! Okongwu tips it forward and beats everybody to the rim. Jackson squares up in the circle, the whistle blows, and he's already in the air. Fire up the jukebox, we're feeling good.

tickets.name: Dame Time
tickets.note: Gather 'round, folks. Ball goes up, Davis goes up higher, and the Wizards have it. That center circle is his front yard, and he mows it every night. Here's Turner, crouched and coiled at center court. Up he goes. Bailey starts every night with a shot, and tonight should be no different. Watson is the fella the scouting report put on page nine, and that's where we found him. If this one hits, I'm dancing in the parking lot!

tickets.name: The Bank Is Open
tickets.note: Road trip! First stop, Davis. Daylight Davis rises, taps, and runs. The Wizards have the ball and he wants it back. Thunder Turner gets the tip, the Bucks get the ball, and the big fella gets position. Okongwu gets the first touch with his fingertips, the second with both hands. There's Jackson in the circle, long as a summer day, and twice as hot. Tougher than a two-day-old biscuit! Ain't nothing quiet about this one.

tickets.name: The Block
tickets.note: Spin the wheel! The Celtics love to start with George, and George loves to start with a shot. Turner reaches for the rafters on the opening toss and taps it home to the Bucks. The Jazz draw it up for Bailey out of the gate, and he obliges. Quicker than a hiccup! Watson gets the leftovers, and some nights the leftovers are the whole buffet. Light the grill, we might be celebrating early.

tickets.name: Sky Hook
tickets.note: Hold onto the porch railing. The Celtics swing it twice, and it ends up where it always does: George. Turner times the toss like a man catching the last bus home. Tougher than a boiled boot! Okongwu flicks the tip to the wing like he's dealing cards. Jackson controls the toss, the Jazz swing it inside, and here comes Jackson again. We're swinging for the rafters tonight.

tickets.name: Dream Shake
tickets.note: Fresh out the oven! Sengun at the opening jump, and he's got springs in those sneakers tonight. Lightning in a mason jar! Win the tip, then dive to the rim: that's how Turner likes to start the evening. Watch Bulldozer Bailey on the opening set: one fake, one dribble, one shot. Watson is a whole lot of upside wearing a Cavaliers jersey. Bring the big foam finger!

tickets.name: Flu Game
tickets.note: Pull up a chair! Toss goes up, and Splash Sengun meets it like they had a lunch date. The ref flips it, Turner flicks it, and the Bucks are off to the races. Jet-Pack Jackson wins the opening tip and the Jazz go right at the rim with him. Nobody drew up a play for Walsh, so he drew one up for himself. Sneakier than a kid in the cookie jar! That's the whole enchilada, folks.

tickets.name: Mr. Big Shot
tickets.note: The whole family's here. Adebayo goes up like he's reaching for the top shelf at the grocery store. Here we go: Turner versus the other big, and Turner gets there a hair early. Tip to the Jazz, a quick swing, and Jackson is sealing his man under the basket. That's a county-fair blue ribbon right there! Go on and get it, boys!

tickets.name: Showtime
tickets.note: Adebayo leads the conga line. Up it goes at center court, and Adebayo snatches the first possession for the Heat. Nobody's guarding Watson, and that's a mistake the Cavaliers love to punish. Sneakier than a fox in the henhouse! Okongwu in the circle, the ref tosses it, and Okongwu swats it right to a teammate. That's a ticket with some swagger.

tickets.name: Bad Boys
tickets.note: Oh, this one's a stew. It's Davis at center court, all elbows and knees and ambition. Turner tips it, the Bucks push it, and he rolls for the first look. Stronger than a mule with a grudge! Jackson rakes the tip and trots to the block like he owns the place. Swing big, baby!

tickets.name: Seven Seconds or Less
tickets.note: The doors are open! Up goes the ball, up goes Davis, and the Wizards come out running. He wins the tip, and the team that wins the tip gets the first crack. Wrecking-Ball Watson grabs the first offensive rebound and lays it right back up. Thompson hits the gas on the opening possession and doesn't tap the brakes. Somebody tell the neighbors, this ticket's got a pulse!

tickets.name: Grit and Grind
tickets.note: Here comes the parade! Here's George, first possession, pulling up like the shot clock owes him rent. Hotter than a fresh-fried hush puppy! Turner wins the jump, trails the play, and the Bucks find him all alone. Jackson gets up so high on the tip he could change a light bulb. Tip it off already, I can't stand the wait!

tickets.name: Splash Brothers
tickets.note: Everybody came hungry. The Celtics come out of the huddle looking for George, and he's looking for the rim. Everybody's watching the stars, so Watson just strolls in for the first bucket. Thompson hits the hesitation, and his man is still looking for his shoe. Get that man a milkshake! Pack a lunch, this one goes the distance.

tickets.name: Run TMC
tickets.note: Tip it off, baby! Sengun springs off that hardwood like somebody swapped it for a trampoline. Turner plants his feet in the circle like a porch post in red clay. Jackson wins the tip, and the Jazz run the first set right back through him. Steadier than a grandfather clock! Lights down low, volume up high!

tickets.name: Twin Towers
tickets.note: Four arenas, one big night. Jump ball. Sengun wins it, and the Rockets go right back to the paint. Watson for the Cavaliers, quiet as a church mouse until he isn't. Put that one on a postcard! Turbo Thompson gets the ball on the first trip, rocks his man to sleep, and rises. Sweet dreams are made of tickets like this.
